Q2FY27 production was the highest ever for a second quarter at 12.16 MnT (+19% YoY), and domestic realisation improved 10% YoY to INR 5,488/t. We believe the YoY margin decline largely reflects higher royalty, levies and freight, and does not change the volume and capacity story. We have not changed our FY27E/FY28E estimates. Higher Costs Weigh on Margin Royalty, levies and freight rose to 44.7% of sales (vs. 36.6% in Q2FY26) and other expenses to 14.7% (vs. 9.0%). EBITDA declined 2.7% YoY to INR 19.4 Bn and margin contracted 203 bps YoY to 29.2%. Higher other income (+29% YoY) limited the fall in Adj. PAT to 1.8%. H2FY27 Needs Sales to Catch Up with Output H1 production of 27.3 MnT was ahead of sales of 22.2 MnT. H1 contributed 42% of our FY27E EBITDA, so our estimates imply H2 EBITDA of about INR 61.4 Bn (28% above H2FY26) on sales of about 31.9 MnT. We expect the inventory built up in H1 and the 2 MTPA Nagarnar pellet plant, commissioned on Sep 27, 2026, to support this. Valuation and Risks Our TP of INR 107 is based on SoTP: core business at 7x FY28E EV/EBITDA (INR 103/share), the NMDC-CMDC JV at 6x with a 30% discount (INR 2/share) and investments at 1.22x book (INR 2/share). The stock trades at 4.7x FY28E EV/EBITDA and has declined 17% since our initiation. Key risks include lower iron ore prices, delays in capacity expansion, higher capex and adverse regulatory changes. 1 60 80 100 120 140 160 180 200 NMDC Ltd. Sales were 10.48 MnT (- 2.2% YoY, -10.6% QoQ) ▪ H1FY27 production was 27.27 MnT (+23% YoY) against sales of 22.21 MnT (flat YoY). Output exceeded dispatches by about 5.1 MnT ▪ Production averaged about 4.05 MnT per month in the quarter Realisation and Costs ▪ Domestic iron ore realisation was INR 5,488/t (+10.4% YoY, -1.1% QoQ). Blended realisation (revenue/volume) was INR 6,332/t (+6.4% YoY) ▪ Royalty, levies and freight were 44.7% of sales (Q2FY26: 36.6%, Q1FY27: 53.6%). Royalty and levies were INR 2,700/t (+33% YoY) ▪ Other expenses rose 70% YoY to INR 9.7 Bn (14.7% of sales vs. 9.0%). Per the company presentation, pellet job-work cost rose 73% QoQ to INR 4.3 Bn Profitability ▪ EBITDA was INR 19.4 Bn (-2.7% YoY, -21.4% QoQ) and margin was 29.2% (-203 bps YoY, -710 bps QoQ).
